trait.name: Totem-bound
trait.text: Start every fight with three different totems: Hawk, Bear and Splinter.

blurb: An elder shaman of the old spirits, who plants totems and wakes them. Starts every fight with three totems (Hawk, Bear and Splinter).
buildPaths: Elements: storm, ice and fire strikes, 0-cost cards and status cards
howTo: You start with a Hawk, a Bear and a Splinter totem. Totems stand in a row of 3 slots beside you and pulse at the end of your turn (the Owl at the start of it). A 4th pushes the oldest out, awakening it for its big effect.
Hawks strike a random enemy, Bears give Barrier, Elders charge up for one big blow on the weakest enemy, Owls give Mana, and Splinters hit every enemy but fade a little each turn.
Spirit makes every totem hit harder and guard more. Many of your Auras stay all fight and build on each other.
Some of your cards make status cards (Haze, Muck, Scorch, Drain, Wound) that clutter your deck; others pay off whenever you make one.
